class.name: PhysXBlastAuthoring
class.brief_description: Scripted/offline mesh fracturing for NVIDIA Blast.
class.description: Cuts a [Mesh] into fracture chunks and returns the result as a ready-to-assign [PhysXBlastAsset]. The editor's right-click [b]Fracture with Blast...[/b] context-menu items (Scene tree and FileSystem docks) use the same code path; prefer them for interactive work. Assign the returned asset to a [PhysXDestructible3D] to instance and simulate it.

method.name: fracture_mesh
method.description: Fractures [param mesh] into up to [param site_count] chunks using [param pattern]. [param seed] makes repeated calls deterministic. With [enum PhysXBlastAuthoring.FracturePattern] [constant PhysXBlastAuthoring.PATTERN_CUTOUT], the texture mask argument limits which regions may be cut. Returns the authored asset, or a valid asset with no chunks on failure.

constants.constant: Recursive plane slicing: slabs and shards.
Cutout fracturing guided by the texture mask argument.
